card.name: Small words before dose in HER2 cancer drugs
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation, mostly "of" after "dose" or "dosages", in dosing sections of HER2 breast cancer drug labels such as trastuzumab, pertuzumab and lapatinib.
